parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is a rotation blade of the folding knife made of stainless steel, typically around 8 cm long and 1.5 cm wide.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one of the cutting edges of the knife, used for slicing or cutting tasks.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot joint to fold into or out of the base body.

parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation blade of the folding knife made of stainless steel, similar in size to the other blades.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an alternative cutting or utility function, possibly serrated or shaped differently for specific uses.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the same pivot mechanism to fold into or out of the base body.

parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the third rotation blade of the folding knife, made of stainless steel and similar in structure to the others.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve a specialized purpose such as sawing or piercing depending on its edge design.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint to fold into or out of the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the folding knife, made of aluminum alloy, approximately 10 cm long and 2 cm wide.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main grip and housing for the rotating blades, providing structural support and safety when blades are folded.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the blades rotate around the pivot attached to it.
